name: China South Publishing & Media Group Co., Ltd
summary: Operating across China, China South Publishing & Media Group Co., Ltd, along with its affiliated companies, is a diversified enterprise involved in publishing, printing, distribution, and various media endeavors. Its extensive publishing portfolio encompasses both general interest titles and educational textbooks. Beyond content creation, the group provides comprehensive printing services, producing a wide array of items such as periodicals, newspapers, packaging materials, invoices, security documents, and advanced digital printing solutions. Additionally, it handles the distribution of published materials and office supplies. The company also extends its reach into digital platforms with websites and online educational initiatives, alongside its traditional magazine and newspaper publishing. A unique aspect of its operations includes organizing automotive trade shows. Established in 2008 and headquartered in Changsha, China, this entity operates as a subsidiary of Hunan Publishing Investment Holding Group Co., Ltd.
